The Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman prayed Eid before the sermon, without adhan or iqamah; the Prophet then urged the women to give alms, and they gave rings.
The Prophet commanded that young, secluded and menstruating women be brought out for the two Eids, the menstruating staying away from the prayer place but joining the supplication.
On Eid the Prophet prayed two rak'ahs, nothing before or after, and told the women to give alms; in Eid prayers he recited Qaf and 'The Hour drew near'.
On Eid the Prophet stopped Abu Bakr scolding two girls singing and drumming, saying every people has a festival, and let Aisha watch Abyssinians play with spears in the mosque.
